stageNotes: Stage 1: apex thegundealer.ca returns HTTP/1.1 200 with cf-ray; www variant 301s to apex. Canonical = apex.

Stage 2: 8-batch probe all 200; cf-ray on every response; honeypot xmlrpc.php/.env return 403 at origin (LiteSpeed/mod_security path-filter, not edge WAF); no rule-selective challenges; verdict cloudflare-passive operational hasWaf=false. reCAPTCHA v3 loaded via CF7 on every page - does not gate catalog fetch path, hasCaptcha=false. No age-gate markup on homepage.

Stage 3: <meta generator> WordPress 6.9.4 + WooCommerce 10.6.0. wp-content/plugins/woocommerce, woocommerce-* CSS classes confirm. Platform=woocommerce, adapterType=woocommerce (table default). needsPlaywright=false (Store API + HTML both return products to plain HTTP).

Stage 4: Taxonomy API returned 283 categories across 3 pages (x-wp-totalpages=3 - paginated all per B3). 30 top-level (parent=0). Excluded 5 non-firearm cats (clothing-footwear 710, fxr 89, gift-card 1, extended-warranty 0, cyber-monday-gift-card 0). 25 firearm-relevant top-level cats kept.
Stage 4g extraction-quality: Store API per_page=3 returned 3 products with title, permalink absolute, price (cents/100), stock (in/out/in). All 4 fields populated.
Stage 5: pagination=path /page/{N}; perPage=24 (page-1 default). p1 vs p2 zero-overlap (p1 ids 213473..213445; p2 ids 213341..205786) - pagination honored.

Stage 6: <select name=orderby> on /shop/ - options popularity/date/price/price-desc, date selected as default. 3-outcome counter-control with cache-bust: default first3=[213473,213467,213448] != ?orderby=price first3=[213489,213490,213491]. Sort honored. default IS newest-first (descending IDs).

Stage 7: Watermark = api-date-since-watermark. Critical: WC Store API silently IGNORES ?modified_after= (returns 11230 for BOTH 2099 and 1999). WP REST core /wp/v2/product HONORS ?modified_after= (returns 0 for 2099). Runtime woocommerce.ts:337 hardcodes modified_after against WP REST core - correct.

Stage 8: expectedProductCount=11230. Triangulated: WC Store API x-wp-total=11230, WP REST core x-wp-total=11230, sitemap loc count = 11230 exact. method=wp-rest-header, endpoint /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products (paired with verifyMethod=store-api per B8). productCountMethod shape validated.
